Stage definitions

Exact slices of the parent sequence.

Canonical instructions, handedness, action width, horizon, and success conditions are drawn from the current task registry and success-contract documentation.

#Stage / environmentHandActionMax stepsSuccess summary
01Open refrigeratorSharpaOpenFridge-v1Left29650Open the door to at least 75° at low angular speed and hold for six steps.
02Move appleSharpaTakeAppleToBlender-v1Right29700Lift the apple out of the refrigerator and settle it inside the blender for 12 steps.
03Close refrigeratorSharpaCloseFridge-v1Left29650Close the door to within 1° at low angular speed and hold for six steps.
04Place blender lidSharpaMobilePlaceBlenderLid-v1Right29400Lift and seat the lid within 5 mm xy, 8 mm z and 15° tilt for 15 steps.
05Press buttonSharpaMobilePressBlenderButton-v1Right29400Depress the 2 mm power button by at least 80% for four steps.
